240-4460-5470-8249.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Repeat from step 2.

2645-3430-5475-5928.easyPrerequisites: Forensic Researcher doesn't have summoning sickness.
2645-3430-5475-5928.description:
Activate Balduvian Trading Post by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{R}{R}{R} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, untapping Balduvian Trading Post
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Forensic Researcher.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

539-728-3249-7316--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
539-728-3249-7316--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Ashaya by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Rat King triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

2105-5778-6633-7392.description:
Cast Combat Celebrant by paying {2}{R} plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
When Combat Celebrant enters, its offspring ability triggers, creating a token copy of it that is 1/1.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Nesting Dovehawk triggers, creating a copy of the Combat Celebrant token.
Declare a Combat Celebrant token as an attacker, choosing to exert it as it attacks. It then triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

1661-4871-5220-8095.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
1661-4871-5220-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

757-3933-5087-5524.easyPrerequisites: Magosi has at least one eon counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
757-3933-5087-5524.description:
During your precombat main phase, use Karn's Bastion to put an additional eon counter on Magosi.
Activate Magosi's third ability by tapping it, removing an eon counter from it and returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
When Magosi leaves the battlefield, The Ozolith's first ability triggers due to Destiny Spinner, putting an eon counter on The Ozolith.
Resolve the Magosi ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Play Magosi.
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Ozolith triggers, moving an eon counter from itself onto Magosi.
Repeat each turn.

1594-2781-5998-6867.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Felidar Guardian with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Felidar Guardian from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Felidar Guardian enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

413-3054-5346-6809.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire.
When Oathsworn Vampire dies, Crime Novelist and Scion of Opulence trigger.
Resolve the Crime Novelist trigger, adding {R} and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Scion of Opulence trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Oathsworn Vampire from your graveyard by paying {1}{B}.
When Oathsworn Vampire enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

2523-2869-3734.description:
Cast Phyrexian Metamorph by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Ratadrabik.
Put Phyrexian Metamorph into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Phyrexian Metamorph dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a token copy of Phyrexian Metamorph that is a copy of Ratadrabik but is a 2/2 Zombie in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 2 using the Phyrexian Metamorph token instead.
2523-2869-3734.notes: This combo produces a mandatory infinite loop that'll cause the game to end in a draw if it isn't interacted with.

719-3490-4659-7665.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
719-3490-4659-7665.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters as a Hero due to Xenograft, Captain America triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and the Servo.
Animation Module triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the first Animation Module trigger, choosing not to pay.
Resolve the second Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3967-6972-7640.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Reputable Merchant.
When Reputable Merchant dies, its innate ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the Reputable Merchant trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Reputable Merchant from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Reputable Merchant enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

4613-5636-7414.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
4613-5636-7414.description:
Activate Pensive Professor using Psychic Frog's ability by discarding a card, putting a +1/+1 counter on Pensive Professor.
Pensive Professor triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

206-240-2438-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness
without summoning sickness and is saddled

1169-3259-5500.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1169-3259-5500.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Seraphic Steed as attackers.
Seraphic Steed triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1169-1563-2457-4365.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

2893-3470-6168-6664.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
When the basic land enters, Lotus Cobra and Obuun trigger.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Obuun trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1339-2122-5231-7061.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
1339-2122-5231-7061.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton's first ability by paying {1} and discarding a card, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Mindless Automaton's second ability by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing an Insect, adding {R}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

2034-3490-4017-4506.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2034-3490-4017-4506.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Auriok Champion triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Sunbond attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

147-2562-6797.description:
Cast Graceful Reprieve by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Graceful Reprieve, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Graceful Reprieve.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, Graceful Reprieve triggers, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Phantom Train abilities from step 5.

2854-3200-4574-5741.easyPrerequisites: Showdown of the Skalds' second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
2854-3200-4574-5741.description:
Cast Urza's Bauble either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}
Showdown of the Skalds triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Activate Urza's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Urza's Bauble from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

6014-6068.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures, one of which must have Dissection Tools attached to it.
6014-6068.description:
Activate Dissection Tools' equip ability by sacrificing the creature it is attached to, targeting another creature you control.
When the creature dies, Guardian of the Forgotten triggers, causing you to manifest the top card of your library.
Resolve the Dissection Tools trigger, attaching it to the targeted creature.
Repeat.

2103-4423-4426-6886.easyPrerequisites:
You control three other Islands.
There is another nonbasic land on the battlefield.
2103-4423-4426-6886.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Dust Bowl by paying {3}, tapping it and sacrificing Mystic Sanctuary, destroying a nonbasic land.
Play Mystic Sanctuary from your graveyard.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Capture of Jingzhou during your draw step.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and is level 4 or higher

1318-2743-6198.description:
Cast Self-Reflection by paying its mana cost, targeting Biovisionary.
Holding priority, activate Echo Mage by tapping it, copying Self-Reflection twice, with both copies targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Self-Reflection spells, creating three token copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers. Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

5641-6012-6258.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}, which enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Thunderous Velocipede.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Thunderous Velocipede.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Reluctant Role Model's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Repeat from step 2.

360-5670-6291.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
360-5670-6291.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
When the Thopter enters the battlefield, Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

366-1339-6092.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
366-1339-6092.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Purphoros triggers, dealing 2 damage to an opponent.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, causing you to draw a number of cards equal to the damage dealt.
Repeat from step 2.
366-1339-6092.notes: You must stop the combo at some point before you draw from an empty library to prevent losing the game by accident, assuming an opponent survives until that point.

1965-4600-5642.manaNeeded: {2} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
1965-4600-5642.description:
Cast Omarthis either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2} plus commander tax, if applicable.
Echoes of Eternity triggers, copying the Omarthis spell.
Resolve the copy of the Omarthis spell, creating a token copy of Omarthis with one +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the original Omarthis spell, causing it to enter the battlefield with one +1/+1 counter on it.
The token Omarthis's first ability triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the token Omarthis.
The nontoken Omarthis's first ability triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the nontoken Omarthis.
Repeat from step 5.

215-2557-4050-4683-5176.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven artifacts.
215-2557-4050-4683-5176.description:
Cast Sojourner's Companion by paying {0}.
Radagast triggers, creating two 3/3 Beast creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Beasts, adding {1}{G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Sojourner's Companion from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1253-2816-4893.notablePrerequisites:
Umbral Mantle attached to Gyre Engineer.
Gyre Engineer does not have summoning sickness.
1253-2816-4893.description:
Activate Gyre Engineer by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Activate Gyre Engineer by paying {1} and untapping it, giving itself +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

3699-3750-4050.notablePrerequisites:
Cadira does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
You control at least five tokens.
3699-3750-4050.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Cadira.
Cadira triggers, creating at least five 1/1 Rabbit creature tokens.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate Phyrexian Altar five times by sacrificing five Rabbits, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.
If you control six or more tokens when Cadira deals combat damage, this combo nets infinite Rabbit tokens and colored mana.

3263-3525-3586.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Magus Lucea Kane.
Magus Lucea Kane does not have summoning sickness.
3263-3525-3586.description:
Activate Magus Lucea Kane by tapping it, adding {2}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {1}, untapping Magus Lucea Kane.
Repeat.
You may then cast a spell or activate an ability with {X} in its mana cost, getting infinite copies of that spell or ability.

391-2404-5200.notablePrerequisites:
Sword of the Paruns attached to Blossom Dryad.
Blossom Dryad does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least four creatures.
391-2404-5200.description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Blossom Dryad by tapping it, untapping Gaea's Cradle.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Blossom Dryad.
Repeat.

1987-2510-3448-4125.notablePrerequisites: Any instant exiled by Semblance Anvil.
1987-2510-3448-4125.description:
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Stadium Vendors and Shipwreck Dowser, blinking them.
When Shipwreck Dowser enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Stadium Vendors enters the battlefield, add {U}{U}.
Repeat.
